# Tomás Pérez — Full-Stack Developer

> Full-stack developer (3+ years) working agentic-first: AI-driven development, harness
> engineering, LLM orchestration and context engineering as part of the daily workflow.
> Backend-oriented across Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js and TypeScript. Based in

## About

Tomás Pérez is a backend-oriented full-stack developer. He builds and modernises
enterprise platforms and ships production SaaS, owning work end-to-end — architecture,
client communication and deploy. He works AI-augmented and agentic-first: AI-driven
development, harness engineering, LLM orchestration and context engineering, with
Claude Code in daily use. English level: B2 (Upper Intermediate, certified).

## Core stack

- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python (side projects)
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs
- Data & Infra: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, Redis, Docker, OpenShift, Vercel
- Architecture: Hexagonal, Clean Architecture, SOLID, Monorepo, Multitenant
- AI tooling: Agentic Workflows, AI-Driven Development, Harness Engineering, Context Engineering, LLM Orchestration

## Featured work

- Zurich / Santander — Enterprise insurance platforms (Full-stack, backend-oriented).
  Legacy modernisation, performance, business-critical features. Fixed 44 security
  vulnerabilities in 2 days; cut PDF report times by 50%.
- DJ Presskit — SaaS, official SoundCloud partner (co-developer, full-stack). Generates
  professional press-kit sites for DJs; multitenant, real-time dashboard, 60+ active artists.
- iPhone BRC — High-conversion e-commerce landing (frontend). 13K+ views in 90 days,
  delivered in under 4 weeks.
